description: This Java source file defines the 'FixedDepositAccount' class, a specialized savings account for fixed deposits within a financial application. It includes methods for account activation, closure, interest calculation, maturity management, and domain validation, as well as handling of deposit terms, interest rate charts, and account lifecycle transitions.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccount
classes.description: Represents a fixed deposit savings account with specialized behavior for deposit management, interest calculation, maturity processing, and account lifecycle within the financial system.

methods.name: createNewApplicationForSubmittal
methods.description: Creates a new fixed deposit application with specified parameters like client, group, product, interest rates, deposit terms, and account settings.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Modifies the application details of the fixed deposit account, including deposit terms and interest parameters.

methods.name: updateMaturityDateAndAmountBeforeAccountActivation
methods.description: Updates the maturity date and maturity amount ahead of account activation.

methods.name: updateMaturityDateAndAmount
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the account's maturity date and maturity amount based on current account details and interest calculations.

methods.name: updateMaturityStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the account to matured if the maturity date has passed.

methods.name: calculateMaturityDate
methods.description: Calculates the maturity date based on deposit period and frequency.

methods.name: prematureClosure
methods.description: Handles the premature closure of the deposit account, including validation and transaction processing.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the deposit account upon maturity, transferring balance and updating status.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the deposit account with initial balance setup.

methods.name: calculatePreMatureAmount
methods.description: Calculates the amount payable if the deposit is closed prematurely.

methods.name: calculatePreMatureInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest accrued up to the premature closure date.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts interest to the account on a specified date, handling transfer and interest period details.

methods.name: calculateInterestUsing
methods.description: Calculates interest over a period using the specified interest rate and period type.

methods.name: interestPostingUpToDate
methods.description: Determines the date up to which interest should be posted.

methods.name: maturityDate
methods.description: Returns the calculated maturity date of the deposit.

methods.name: maturityAmount
methods.description: Returns the calculated maturity amount of the deposit.

methods.name: totalInterestPosted
methods.description: Sums all interest transactions that have been posted and not reversed.

methods.name: allowDeposit
methods.description: Indicates whether deposits are allowed (returns false for fixed deposit).

methods.name: allowWithdrawal
methods.description: Indicates whether withdrawals are allowed (returns false for fixed deposit).

methods.name: allowModify
methods.description: Indicates whether account modifications are permitted (returns false for fixed deposit).

methods.name: isTransactionsAllowed
methods.description: Checks if transactions are permitted based on account status.

methods.name: loadLazyCollections
methods.description: Loads lazily fetched collections such as interest rate charts.

methods.name: getDepositAmount
methods.description: Returns the deposit amount for the account.

methods.name: getAccountBalance
methods.description: Returns the current account balance.

methods.name: isMatured
methods.description: Checks if the account has matured.

methods.name: setClosedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the account was closed.
